function.name: sql_query_tool
function.description: Run ONE read-only SQL SELECT (DuckDB dialect) against the structured tables: compounds, clinical_trials, trial_sites, lab_results, adverse_events, research_documents (metadata only), agent_interaction_logs. Use for counts, filters, joins, enrollment %, rankings. Max 100 rows returned.

query.description: A single SELECT or WITH statement. No writes, no semicolon-separated batches.

function.name: statistics_tool
function.description: Compute a descriptive statistic on a numeric column, optionally grouped. Metrics: mean, median, std, min, max, sum, count, pass_rate (lab_results only; group by experiment_type or compound_id), correlation (needs column2).

function.name: compound_profile_tool
function.description: One-call 360 degree profile of a compound: master data, lab-assay summary (pass rates), all linked trials with enrollment %, adverse-event counts across those trials, and the ids of related research documents. Use for 'full picture' questions.

function.name: vector_search_tool
function.description: Semantic search over the internal research-document corpus (lab notebooks, literature reviews, memos, regulatory briefings, SOP deviation reports, conference abstracts). Returns ranked, citable passages with doc_id. An empty result means nothing relevant exists - never guess.

function.name: citation_formatter_tool
function.description: Format research-document ids into standard citations (id, title, author, date, type).

function.name: ae_severity_classifier_tool
function.description: Classify an adverse event into priority P1 (critical) .. P4 (low) using seriousness, severity, causality and outcome, plus trial context (repeat-term signal). Pass event_id to look the event up, or supply the fields directly. P1 means escalation is mandatory.

function.name: escalation_notifier_tool
function.description: Escalate an adverse event to the human Pharmacovigilance Safety Review Board (simulated: writes a ticket). Mandatory for every P1 / Serious event. Idempotent per event_id.

function.name: compound_similarity_tool
function.description: Find the k most similar compounds to a given compound using chemical class, therapeutic area, target protein, phase and physico-chemical properties (cosine similarity). Returns shared attributes for explainability.
